test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of mobile phones sold by six companies in a year. The total mobile phones sold by six companies are 300. Number of mobile phones sold by a particular company is shown as a percentage of total number of mobile phones sold by all these six companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3d2b0f6f48fda3b407758e9a243efd608cd5aea7e43791f0be7430028e7b928.png] 

What is the average number of mobile phones sold by Q and S?
solution:
**Calculation**

The average number of mobile phones sold by Q and S = (25% + 15%)/2

= 20%

100% → 300

20% → 300 × 20/100 = 60

**The answer is 60.**
